segments.text: to find sub arrays of a fixed size within an array efficiently.
Suppose you have to find a sub array of size k with a maximum sum in an array.
Then this sliding window method proves handy.
Initially select the first sub array from index 0 to k-1 and store its size somewhere.
Consider this selected range of elements as a window from index 0 to k-1.
Now slide the window by one element that is from index 1 to k.
Now add the value at index k to the last calculated sum and subtract the value
It will give you the size of this new window, that is this new selected sub array.
If it's greater than the size of the previous sub array, then consider it as the maximum
until you get another sub array with more sum.
Then again shift the window by one element and repeat the same process to find the
new sub array and calculate its sum using this
